Synopsis: The remote host is using a version of GnuTLS that is affected by a key extraction vulnerability.
Description: The version of GnuTLS installed on the remote host is affected by a vulnerability that allows RSA key extraction.
Solution: Update GnuTLS to the latest version.

Plugin Name: Apache Tomcat AJP Ghostcat File Read/Include
Synopsis: The Apache Tomcat AJP connector is affected by a file read/include vulnerability.
Description: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read web application files or include files from the Tomcat server.
Solution: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to version 9.0.31 or later.

Plugin Name: SSL/TLS: Server Supports Weak Cipher Suites
Synopsis: The remote host supports weak cipher suites.
Description: The SSL/TLS server is configured to support one or more cipher suites that are considered weak.
Solution: Configure the server to disable weak cipher suites and only enable strong ones.

Synopsis: The web server is leaking version information.
Description: The remote web server discloses its version in the HTTP response headers.
Solution: Configure the web server to hide version information.

Synopsis: MySQL database information can be enumerated.
Description: The remote MySQL server allows enumeration of database names and table structures.
Solution: Restrict MySQL access to authorized hosts only.

Synopsis: The PHP version is disclosed in the HTTP response headers.
Description: The remote web server is running PHP and discloses its version number.
Solution: Configure PHP to hide version information.

Synopsis: SSH server public key information was collected.
Description: The SSH server public key and fingerprint are available.

Synopsis: The SSH server supports CBC mode ciphers.
Description: The remote SSH server is configured to support CBC mode cipher suites which may be vulnerable.
Solution: Configure SSH to disable CBC mode ciphers.

Synopsis: The MySQL server has a weak password configured.
Description: The remote MySQL server is using a weak password that can be easily brute-forced.
Solution: Set a strong password for the MySQL root account.
